section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the results of a study (referred to as Study X) that investigates the relationships between insight, fluid intelligence (Gf), personality (openness), and creative achievement/behavior, comparing findings to a previous 'Study 1'. Insight was modeled as a latent variable, and Gf was indicated by paper folding and series completion tasks. Creative achievement was measured by the global CAQ, and everyday creative behavior by the BICB. The results indicate that insight was unrelated to real-world creativity or everyday creative behavior, while Gf and openness significantly predicted creative achievement and behavior.
